            require(questions[key]["status"] == "answered", "lot requires unresolved detail: " + key)
        else:
            require(elements[key]["approval"] in ("accepted", "validated"), "lot requires unapproved detail: " + key)


def check_lot(root, code_root, lot, lots, elements, questions, authorities, design_manifest):
    check_details(lot, elements, questions)
    for key in lot["prerequisites"]:
        dependency = lot["dependency_kinds"][key]
        proofs(root, dependency.get("evidence"), "available dependency evidence", nonempty=True)
        if dependency["kind"] == "CODE":
            source_files(code_root, dependency.get("outputs"), "available CODE outputs/API", nonempty=True)
        if dependency["kind"] == "EXECUTION":
            require(lots[key].get("status") == "completed", "EXECUTION prerequisite not completed: " + key)
    pre = lot.get("preconditions")
    require(isinstance(pre, dict), "lot preconditions missing")
    guard = pre.get("railguard")
    require(isinstance(guard, dict) and guard.get("activation") == "active", "lot requires active railguard")
    proof(root, guard.get("ref"), "railguard.ref")
    proofs(root, guard.get("hashes"), "railguard.hashes", nonempty=guard["activation"] == "active")
    auth = pre.get("authorization")
    require(isinstance(auth, dict), "scoped authorization missing")
    granting = authorities.get(auth.get("authority"), {})
    require(granting.get("role") in ("user", "governance", "implementer"), "scoped authorization authority missing")
    require(auth.get("lot_id") == lot["id"], "authorization lot mismatch")
    proof(root, auth.get("source"), "authorization.source")
    allowed = unique_paths(auth.get("paths"), canonical_input=True)
    require(set(lot["paths"]) <= set(allowed), "lot paths exceed authorization")
    if granting["role"] != "user":
        require(lot["id"] in granting["scope"].get("lot_ids", []) and set(allowed) <= set(granting["scope"].get("paths", [])), "authorization exceeds delegated lot/path scope")
    drift = pre.get("drift")
    require(isinstance(drift, dict) and drift.get("classification") in ("none", "expected_previous_lots"), "preflight drift classification missing")
    refs(drift.get("previous_lots"), lots, "drift.previous_lots")
    require(set(drift["previous_lots"]) <= set(lot["prerequisites"]), "drift references non-prerequisite lots")
    if drift["classification"] == "none":
        require(not drift["previous_lots"], "none drift cannot name previous lots")
    else:
        require(drift["previous_lots"], "expected drift requires previous lots")
    proofs(root, drift.get("evidence"), "drift.evidence", nonempty=True)
    proofs(root, pre.get("repository_evidence", []), "repository preconditions evidence")
    check_ledger(root, code_root, lot, lots, pre.get("code_state"), design_manifest)


def source_files(root, values, label, nonempty=False):
    require(isinstance(values, list), label + " must be an array")
    if nonempty:
        require(values, label + " must not be empty")
    for entry in values:
        require(isinstance(entry, dict) and set(entry) == {"path", "sha256"}, "invalid " + label + " file reference")
        path = normalized_path(entry.get("path"))
        require(path == entry["path"], "noncanonical " + label + " path")
        require(isinstance(entry.get("sha256"), str) and HEX.fullmatch(entry["sha256"]), "invalid " + label + " SHA256")
        actual = resolved_path(root, path)
        require(actual.is_file(), label + " file missing: " + path)
        require(file_hash(actual) == entry["sha256"], "stale " + label + " file: " + path)
    paths = [entry["path"] for entry in values]
    require(paths == unique_paths(paths, canonical_input=True), label + " paths must be sorted and unique")


def check_build_environment(root, matrix):
    """Run only bounded, non-shell probes declared by a build environment matrix."""
    root = Path(root).resolve()
    spec = read_json(matrix) if not isinstance(matrix, dict) else matrix
    require(isinstance(spec, dict) and set(spec) == {"schema", "checks"}
            and spec.get("schema") == "rust-predev-build-env/1", "unsupported build environment matrix")
    checks = spec.get("checks")
    require(isinstance(checks, list) and checks, "build environment matrix checks must be nonempty")
    ids, results = set(), []
    probes = {"rustc": ["--version"], "cargo": ["--version"], "cmake": ["--version"],
              "ninja": ["--version"], "clang": ["--version"], "clang-cl": ["--version"],
              "nvcc": ["--version"], "cl": ["/?"]}
    for check in checks:
        require(isinstance(check, dict), "build environment check must be an object")
        check_id = identifier(check.get("id"), "build environment check id")
        require(check_id not in ids, "duplicate build environment check: " + check_id)
        ids.add(check_id)
        kind = check.get("kind")
        required = check.get("required", True)
        require(type(required) is bool, "build environment required must be boolean")
        status, details = "READY", {}
        if kind == "executable":
            require(set(check) <= {"id", "kind", "name", "required", "version_pattern"}, "unknown executable probe fields")
            name = check.get("name")
            require(isinstance(name, str) and Path(name).name == name and name.casefold() in probes,
                    "executable probe must use a supported tool name")
            resolved = shutil.which(name)
            details["name"] = name
            if resolved is None:
                status = "MISSING"
            else:
                try:
                    probe_env = os.environ.copy()
                    probe_env["RUSTUP_AUTO_INSTALL"] = "0"
                    result = subprocess.run([resolved, *probes[name.casefold()]], cwd=Path(tempfile.gettempdir()),
                                             stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL, stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
                                             stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, timeout=10, check=False, text=True,
                                             errors="replace", shell=False, env=probe_env)
                    first_line = next((line.strip() for line in result.stdout.splitlines() if line.strip()), "")[:240]
                    details.update(path=str(Path(resolved).resolve()), version_line=first_line or None,
                                   probe_exit=result.returncode)
                    pattern = check.get("version_pattern")
                    if pattern is not None:
                        require(isinstance(pattern, str) and len(pattern) <= 200, "invalid version_pattern")
                        try:
                            matched = re.search(pattern, result.stdout, re.IGNORECASE) is not None
                        except re.error as exc:
                            raise ControlError("invalid version_pattern: " + str(exc)) from exc
                        details["version_match"] = matched
                        if not matched:
                            status = "MISSING"
                    if result.returncode != 0:
                        details["probe_exit"] = result.returncode
                        status = "NOT CHECKED"
                except (OSError, subprocess.TimeoutExpired) as exc:
                    details["probe_error"] = type(exc).__name__
                    status = "NOT CHECKED"
        elif kind == "path":
            require(set(check) <= {"id", "kind", "path", "entry_type", "required"}, "unknown path probe fields")
            target = resolved_path(root, check.get("path"))
            entry_type = check.get("entry_type", "file")
            require(entry_type in ("file", "directory"), "path entry_type must be file or directory")
            exists = target.is_file() if entry_type == "file" else target.is_dir()
            details.update(path=check["path"], entry_type=entry_type, exists=exists)
            if not exists:
                status = "MISSING"
        elif kind == "env":
            require(set(check) <= {"id", "kind", "name", "required", "path_type"}, "unknown environment probe fields")
            name = check.get("name")
            require(isinstance(name, str) and re.fullmatch(r"[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*", name), "invalid environment variable name")
            value = os.environ.get(name)
            details.update(name=name, configured=bool(value))
            if not value:
                status = "MISSING"
            elif check.get("path_type") is not None:
                path_type = check["path_type"]
                require(path_type in ("file", "directory"), "env path_type must be file or directory")
                target = Path(value).expanduser().resolve()
                exists = target.is_file() if path_type == "file" else target.is_dir()
                details.update(path_type=path_type, target_exists=exists)
                if not exists:
                    status = "MISSING"
        else:
            raise ControlError("unsupported build environment probe kind: " + str(kind))
        if not required and status == "MISSING":
            status = "NOT REQUIRED"
        results.append({"id": check_id, "kind": kind, "required": required, "status": status, **details})
    overall = "PASS" if all(not r["required"] or r["status"] == "READY" for r in results) else "BLOCKED"
    return {"ok": overall == "PASS", "schema": spec["schema"], "status": overall,
            "root": str(root), "checks": results}


def validate_execution_packet(root, code_root, state, packet):
    """Validate one shared implementation/review/validation evidence envelope."""
    root, code_root = Path(root).resolve(), Path(code_root).resolve()
    packet_file = Path(packet).resolve()
    require(packet_file.is_relative_to(root) and packet_file.is_file(), "execution packet must be a file under documentation root")
    value = read_json(packet_file)
    require(isinstance(value, dict) and value.get("schema") == "rust-predev-execution/1",
            "unsupported execution evidence schema")
    require(set(value) == {"schema", "lot_id", "candidate_digests", "candidate_fingerprint", "outputs", "artifacts",
                           "environment_matrix", "environment_result", "commands", "review", "validation"},
            "execution evidence packet fields mismatch")
    s = read_json(state) if not isinstance(state, dict) else state
    checked = check_state(root, s, code_root=code_root)
    lots = {item["id"]: item for item in s["lots"]}
    lot_id = value.get("lot_id")
    require(lot_id in lots, "execution packet lot_id unknown")
    lot = lots[lot_id]
    require(lot.get("status", "planned") == "planned", "lot is already completed")
    require(value.get("candidate_digests") == checked["candidate_digests"], "execution packet candidate digests stale/mismatch")
    outputs = value.get("outputs")
    source_files(code_root, outputs, "execution outputs", nonempty=True)
    require([entry["path"] for entry in outputs] == unique_paths([entry["path"] for entry in outputs], canonical_input=True),
            "execution outputs must be sorted and unique")
    require(set(entry["path"] for entry in outputs) <= set(lot["paths"]), "execution output outside lot paths")
    fingerprint = payload_digest(outputs)
    require(value.get("candidate_fingerprint") == fingerprint, "execution candidate fingerprint mismatch")
    source_files(code_root, value.get("artifacts"), "execution artifacts")

    matrix = value.get("environment_matrix")
    environment = check_build_environment(code_root, matrix)
    require(environment["ok"], "required build environment is not ready")
    require(value.get("environment_result") == environment, "recorded build environment result is stale/mismatch")

    commands = value.get("commands")
    require(isinstance(commands, list) and commands, "execution commands must be nonempty")
    command_ids, required_commands = set(), []
    for command in commands:
        require(isinstance(command, dict) and set(command) == {
            "id", "argv", "cwd", "target", "features", "required", "status", "exit_code", "candidate_fingerprint", "log"
        }, "invalid execution command record")
        command_id = identifier(command.get("id"), "execution command id")
        require(command_id not in command_ids, "duplicate execution command id")
        command_ids.add(command_id)
        require(isinstance(command.get("argv"), list) and command["argv"] and all(isinstance(arg, str) for arg in command["argv"]),
                "execution argv must be a nonempty string array")
        require(isinstance(command.get("cwd"), str) and command["cwd"], "execution cwd missing")
        require(isinstance(command.get("target"), str) and isinstance(command.get("features"), list), "execution target/features invalid")
        require(type(command.get("required")) is bool, "execution command required must be boolean")
        require(command.get("status") in ("PASS", "FAIL", "NOT RUN"), "invalid execution command status")
        require(command.get("candidate_fingerprint") == fingerprint, "command evidence belongs to another candidate")
        if command["status"] == "NOT RUN":
            require(command.get("exit_code") is None and command.get("log") is None, "NOT RUN command cannot claim exit/log")
        else:
            require(type(command.get("exit_code")) is int, "executed command exit_code missing")
            proof(root, command.get("log"), "execution command log")
            require((command["status"] == "PASS") == (command["exit_code"] == 0), "command status/exit_code mismatch")
        if command["required"]:
            required_commands.append(command)
    require(required_commands and all(item["status"] == "PASS" for item in required_commands),
            "required execution commands are not all PASS")

    plans = s["candidates"].get("PLANS")
    require(isinstance(plans, dict), "PLANS candidate required for lot completion")
    review = value.get("review")
    require(isinstance(review, dict) and set(review) == {"authority", "verdict", "candidate_fingerprint", "evidence"}
            and review.get("verdict") == "CLEAN" and review.get("candidate_fingerprint") == fingerprint,
            "review evidence candidate mismatch")
    reviewer = next((item for item in s["authorities"] if item["id"] == review.get("authority")), None)
    require(reviewer is not None and reviewer.get("role") == "reviewer", "implementation review authority must have reviewer role")
    implementers = [item["id"] for item in s["authorities"]
                    if item.get("role") == "implementer"
                    and lot_id in item.get("scope", {}).get("lot_ids", [])
                    and set(lot["paths"]) <= set(item.get("scope", {}).get("paths", []))]
    require(implementers and set(implementers) <= set(reviewer.get("independent_from", [])),
            "implementation reviewer must be declared independent from implementer authorities")
    proof(root, review.get("evidence"), "execution reviewer report")
    validation = value.get("validation")
    require(isinstance(validation, dict) and set(validation) == {"status", "candidate_fingerprint", "evidence"}
            and validation.get("status") == "CHECKS_PASSED"
            and validation.get("candidate_fingerprint") == fingerprint, "candidate-bound validation CHECKS_PASSED required")
    proofs(root, validation.get("evidence"), "execution validation evidence", nonempty=True)
    return {"packet": value, "packet_ref": {"path": normalized_path(packet_file.relative_to(root).as_posix()),
                                              "sha256": file_hash(packet_file)},
            "lot": lot, "outputs": outputs, "fingerprint": fingerprint, "candidate_digests": checked["candidate_digests"]}


def prepare_lot_completion(root, code_root, state_path, packet_path, pending_path):
    """Prepare a validated pending checkpoint; current state is never overwritten."""
    root = Path(root).resolve()
    packet_file = Path(packet_path).resolve()
    require(packet_file.is_relative_to(root), "execution packet must be inside documentation root")
    state_file = Path(state_path).resolve()
    require(state_file.is_relative_to(root) and state_file.is_file(), "current state must be a file under documentation root")
    packet_rel = packet_file.relative_to(root).as_posix()
    packet_hash = file_hash(packet_file)
    state = read_json(state_file)
    result = validate_execution_packet(root, code_root, state, packet_file)
    pending = json.loads(json.dumps(state, ensure_ascii=False))
    lot = next(item for item in pending["lots"] if item["id"] == result["lot"]["id"])
    lot["status"] = "completed"
    lot["completion_evidence"] = [{"path": packet_rel, "sha256": packet_hash}]

    # Carry the completed lot's outputs into every dependent lot's execution ledger.
    ancestors = {lot["id"]}
    changed = True
    while changed:
        changed = False
        for child in pending["lots"]:
            if child["id"] not in ancestors and set(child.get("prerequisites", [])) & ancestors:
                ancestors.add(child["id"])
                changed = True
    for child in pending["lots"]:
        if child["id"] == lot["id"] or not set(child.get("prerequisites", [])) & ancestors:
            continue
        if lot["id"] in child.get("dependency_kinds", {}):
            dependency = child["dependency_kinds"][lot["id"]]
            dependency["evidence"] = [{"path": packet_rel, "sha256": packet_hash}]
            if dependency.get("kind") == "CODE":
                dependency["outputs"] = result["outputs"]
        pre = child.get("preconditions", {})
        code_state = pre.get("code_state")
        if not isinstance(code_state, dict):
            continue
        ledger = code_state.get("ledger", [])
        require(isinstance(code_state.get("baseline"), list) and isinstance(ledger, list),
                "dependent code_state baseline/ledger must be prepared before completion")
        for output in result["outputs"]:
            entry = {"lot_id": lot["id"], "path": output["path"], "sha256": output["sha256"],
                     "evidence": [{"path": packet_rel, "sha256": packet_hash}]}
            prior = [item for item in ledger if item.get("lot_id") == lot["id"] and item.get("path") == output["path"]]
            require(not prior or prior == [entry], "conflicting completed output already exists in dependent ledger")
            if not prior:
                ledger.append(entry)
        lot_order = {item["id"]: index for index, item in enumerate(pending["lots"])}
        code_state["ledger"] = sorted(ledger, key=lambda item: (lot_order[item["lot_id"]], item["path"]))
        current_paths = {item["path"] for item in code_state["baseline"]} | {item["path"] for item in code_state["ledger"]}
        current = []
        for path in sorted(current_paths):
            actual = resolved_path(code_root, path)
            require(actual.is_file(), "dependent code_state path missing after completion: " + path)
            current.append({"path": path, "sha256": file_hash(actual)})
        code_state["current"] = current

    completed_tasks = set(lot.get("tasks", []))
    pending["checkpoint"]["pending_tasks"] = [task for task in pending["checkpoint"]["pending_tasks"] if task not in completed_tasks]
    remaining = [item for item in pending["lots"] if item.get("status", "planned") != "completed"]
    next_lot = remaining[0] if remaining else None
    if next_lot is not None:
        pending["checkpoint"]["pending_tasks"] = list(next_lot.get("tasks", []))
        coordinators = [item["id"] for item in pending["authorities"] if item.get("role") == "coordinator"]
        if len(coordinators) == 1:
            pending["checkpoint"]["next_actor"] = coordinators[0]
    check_state(root, pending, code_root=code_root)
    target = Path(pending_path).resolve()
    require(target.is_relative_to(root), "pending checkpoint must stay inside documentation root")
    require(not target.exists(), "pending checkpoint already exists; refusing overwrite")
    require(target.parent.is_dir() and not target.parent.is_symlink(), "pending checkpoint parent must exist and not be a symlink")
    with target.open("xb") as stream:
        stream.write(canonical(pending))
        stream.flush()
        os.fsync(stream.fileno())
    return {"ok": True, "pending": str(target), "pending_sha256": file_hash(target),
            "completed_lot": lot["id"], "next_lot": next_lot["id"] if next_lot else None,
            "next_actor": pending["checkpoint"]["next_actor"], "pending_tasks": pending["checkpoint"]["pending_tasks"],
            "candidate_fingerprint": result["fingerprint"]}


def check_flow_metrics(root, metrics):
    root = Path(root).resolve()
    value = read_json(metrics) if not isinstance(metrics, dict) else metrics
    require(isinstance(value, dict) and set(value) == {"schema", "lot_id", "baseline_status", "baseline_refs", "timestamps", "counts", "evidence_refs"}
            and value.get("schema") == "rust-predev-flow-metrics/1", "unsupported flow metrics schema")
    identifier(value.get("lot_id"), "flow metrics lot_id")
    require(value.get("baseline_status") in ("COMPARABLE", "BASELINE NOT AVAILABLE"), "invalid flow metrics baseline_status")
    proofs(root, value.get("baseline_refs"), "flow metrics baseline_refs", nonempty=value["baseline_status"] == "COMPARABLE")
    if value["baseline_status"] == "BASELINE NOT AVAILABLE":
        require(value["baseline_refs"] == [], "unavailable baseline cannot cite comparison refs")
    proofs(root, value.get("evidence_refs"), "flow metrics evidence_refs", nonempty=True)
    timestamps = value.get("timestamps")
    required_times = {"handoff", "first_edit", "implementation_done", "next_gate"}
    require(isinstance(timestamps, dict) and set(timestamps) == required_times, "flow metrics timestamps fields mismatch")
    instants = {}
    for key, raw in timestamps.items():
        require(isinstance(raw, str), "flow metrics timestamp must be ISO 8601 text")
        try:
            parsed = datetime.fromisoformat(raw)
        except ValueError as exc:
            raise ControlError("invalid flow metrics timestamp: " + key) from exc
        require(parsed.utcoffset() is not None, "flow metrics timestamps must include a timezone offset")
        instants[key] = parsed
    ordered = ["handoff", "first_edit", "implementation_done", "next_gate"]
    require(all(instants[a] <= instants[b] for a, b in zip(ordered, ordered[1:])), "flow metrics timestamps are out of order")
    counts = value.get("counts")
    required_counts = {"human_round_trips", "repeated_questions", "late_environment_blockers", "manual_state_reconciliations"}
    require(isinstance(counts, dict) and set(counts) == required_counts, "flow metrics counts fields mismatch")
    require(all(type(counts[key]) is int and counts[key] >= 0 for key in required_counts), "flow metric counts must be nonnegative integers")
    return {"ok": True, "schema": value["schema"], "lot_id": value["lot_id"],
            "baseline_comparable": value["baseline_status"] == "COMPARABLE", "counts": counts,
            "durations_seconds": {
                "handoff_to_first_edit": int((instants["first_edit"] - instants["handoff"]).total_seconds()),
                "implementation_to_next_gate": int((instants["next_gate"] - instants["implementation_done"]).total_seconds())}}


def check_ledger(root, code_root, lot, lots, state, design_manifest):
    """Compare scoped raw current bytes against declared baseline + completed outputs."""
    require(isinstance(state, dict), "lot code_state baseline/current/ledger missing")
    current = state.get("current")
    source_files(code_root, current, "code_state.current")
    baseline = state.get("baseline")
    ledger = state.get("ledger")
    require(isinstance(baseline, list) and isinstance(ledger, list), "code baseline/ledger must be arrays")
    expected = {}
    bound_snapshots = {entry["path"]: entry["sha256"] for entry in design_manifest["files"]}
    for entry in baseline:
        require(isinstance(entry, dict), "invalid code baseline")
        path = normalized_path(entry.get("path"))
        require(path == entry["path"] and path not in expected, "duplicate/noncanonical baseline path")
        proof(root, entry.get("snapshot"), "code baseline.snapshot")
        require(bound_snapshots.get(entry["snapshot"]["path"]) == entry["snapshot"]["sha256"], "D0 snapshot must be bound to DESIGN manifest")
        require(entry.get("sha256") == entry["snapshot"]["sha256"], "baseline bytes must equal snapshot bytes")
        identifier(entry.get("revision"), "baseline.revision")
        require(isinstance(entry.get("dirty_hash"), str) and HEX.fullmatch(entry["dirty_hash"]), "baseline dirty_hash missing/invalid")
        expected[path] = entry["sha256"]
    ancestors = set()
    def collect(key):
        for parent in lots[key]["prerequisites"]:
            if parent not in ancestors:
                ancestors.add(parent)
                collect(parent)
    collect(lot["id"])
    prior_seen, last_producer = set(), {}
    for entry in ledger:
        require(isinstance(entry, dict), "invalid ledger entry")
        producer = entry.get("lot_id")
        require(producer in ancestors and lots[producer].get("status") == "completed", "ledger output must belong to completed ancestor lot")
        path = normalized_path(entry.get("path"))
        require(path == entry["path"] and path in lots[producer]["paths"], "ledger output outside producer scope")
        require((producer, path) not in prior_seen, "duplicate ledger output")
        prior_seen.add((producer, path))
        if path in last_producer:
            earlier = last_producer[path]
            producer_ancestors = set()
            def previous(key):
                for parent in lots[key]["prerequisites"]:
                    if parent not in producer_ancestors:
                        producer_ancestors.add(parent)
                        previous(parent)
            previous(producer)
            require(earlier in producer_ancestors, "ledger overlapping outputs must follow dependency order")
        last_producer[path] = producer
        require(isinstance(entry.get("sha256"), str) and HEX.fullmatch(entry["sha256"]), "ledger SHA256 invalid")
        proofs(root, entry.get("evidence"), "ledger.evidence", nonempty=True)
        expected[path] = entry["sha256"]
    require(set(expected) == {p["path"] for p in current}, "code current inventory differs from baseline/ledger")
    for entry in current:
        require(entry["sha256"] == expected[entry["path"]], "unexpected current code drift: " + entry["path"])


def promote_checkpoint(root, pending, current, code_root=None):
    # Validate exactly the bytes being promoted before touching an existing checkpoint.
    pending_bytes = Path(pending).read_bytes()
    value = read_json(pending)
    check_state(root, value, code_root=code_root)
    require(Path(pending).read_bytes() == pending_bytes, "pending checkpoint changed during validation")
    target = Path(current).resolve()
    base = Path(root).resolve()
    require(target.is_relative_to(base), "current checkpoint must stay within root")
    protected = set()
    def protect_refs(obj):
        if isinstance(obj, dict):
            if set(obj) == {"path", "sha256"}:
                protected.add(rooted(root, obj["path"]))
            for child in obj.values():
                protect_refs(child)
        elif isinstance(obj, list):
            for child in obj:
                protect_refs(child)
    protect_refs(value)
    for candidate in value["candidates"].values():
        manifest_path = rooted(root, candidate["manifest"])
        protected.add(manifest_path)
        for entry in verify_manifest(root, manifest_path, check_corpus=candidate["status"] != "STALE")["files"]:
            protected.add(resolved_path(root, entry["path"]))
    require(target not in protected, "current checkpoint would overwrite corpus/manifest/evidence")
    target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    fd, tmp = tempfile.mkstemp(prefix=".predev-", suffix=".json", dir=target.parent)
    try:
        with os.fdopen(fd, "wb") as stream:
            stream.write(canonical(value))
            stream.flush()
            os.fsync(stream.fileno())
        os.replace(tmp, target)
    finally:
        if os.path.exists(tmp):
            os.unlink(tmp)
    return {"ok": True, "current": str(target)}


def main(argv=None):
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    sub = parser.add_subparsers(dest="command", required=True)
    create = sub.add_parser("create-manifest")
    create.add_argument("--root", required=True)
    create.add_argument("--scope", choices=("DESIGN", "PLANS"), required=True)
    create.add_argument("--candidate-id", required=True)
    create.add_argument("--design-candidate-id")
    create.add_argument("--files-list", required=True, help="path to a JSON array of relative paths")
    create.add_argument("--output", required=True)
    verify = sub.add_parser("verify-manifest")
    verify.add_argument("--root", required=True)
    verify.add_argument("--manifest", required=True)
    check = sub.add_parser("check-state")
    check.add_argument("--root", required=True)
    check.add_argument("--state", required=True)
    check.add_argument("--code-root", help="repository root for code_state/current and CODE outputs; defaults to --root")
    check.add_argument("--lot")
    environment = sub.add_parser("check-build-environment")
    environment.add_argument("--root", required=True, help="repository root for relative path probes")
    environment.add_argument("--matrix", required=True, help="rust-predev-build-env/1 JSON matrix")
    complete = sub.add_parser("prepare-lot-completion")
    complete.add_argument("--root", required=True, help="documentation root")
    complete.add_argument("--code-root", required=True, help="repository root containing implementation outputs")
    complete.add_argument("--state", required=True, help="current controlled state JSON")
    complete.add_argument("--packet", required=True, help="execution evidence packet under --root")
    complete.add_argument("--pending", required=True, help="new pending checkpoint path under --root")
    metrics = sub.add_parser("check-flow-metrics")
    metrics.add_argument("--root", required=True, help="documentation root")
    metrics.add_argument("--metrics", required=True, help="rust-predev-flow-metrics/1 JSON")
    promote = sub.add_parser("promote-checkpoint")
    promote.add_argument("--root", required=True)
    promote.add_argument("--pending", required=True)
    promote.add_argument("--current", required=True)
    promote.add_argument("--code-root", help="repository root for code_state/current and CODE outputs; defaults to --root")
    args = parser.parse_args(argv)
    try:
        if args.command == "create-manifest":
            value = create_manifest(args.root, args.scope, args.candidate_id, read_json(args.files_list), args.design_candidate_id)
            target = Path(args.output).resolve()
            require(target.is_relative_to(Path(args.root).resolve()), "manifest output must stay within root")
            require(target not in [rooted(args.root, entry["path"]) for entry in value["files"]], "manifest output cannot overwrite corpus file")
            target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            target.write_bytes(canonical(value))
            result = {"ok": True, "digest": value["digest"], "output": str(target)}
        elif args.command == "verify-manifest":
            value = verify_manifest(args.root, args.manifest)
            result = {"ok": True, "scope": value["scope"], "candidate_id": value["candidate_id"], "digest": value["digest"]}
        elif args.command == "check-state":
            result = check_state(args.root, args.state, args.lot, args.code_root)
        elif args.command == "promote-checkpoint":
            result = promote_checkpoint(args.root, args.pending, args.current, args.code_root)
        elif args.command == "check-build-environment":
            result = check_build_environment(args.root, args.matrix)
        elif args.command == "check-flow-metrics":
            result = check_flow_metrics(args.root, args.metrics)
        else:
            result = prepare_lot_completion(args.root, args.code_root, args.state, args.packet, args.pending)
        sys.stdout.buffer.write(canonical(result))
        return 0
    except (ControlError, OSError, TypeError, KeyError) as exc:
        sys.stderr.write("predev-control: " + str(exc) + "\n")
        return 1


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Persist attributed readOnly proposals in explicitly allowed documentation roots."""
import argparse
import hashlib
import os
from pathlib import Path
import re
import shutil
import sys
import uuid

# CLI persistence must not leave interpreter cache files in the installed pack.
sys.dont_write_bytecode = True
import predev_control as pc

SCHEMA = "rust-predev-host/1"
SAFE_ID = re.compile(r"[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_-]{0,95}\Z")
DOC_EXTENSIONS = {".md", ".json", ".txt", ".csv", ".tsv"}
FORBIDDEN = {".git", ".codex", "cargo.toml", "cargo.lock", "config.toml", "memory", "memories", "config"}
RESERVED = {"proposal.json", "receipt.json", "manifest.json", "transport-manifest.json"}


def safe_id(value, label):
    pc.require(isinstance(value, str) and SAFE_ID.fullmatch(value), label + " must be a safe immutable version ID")
    pc.require(value.upper() not in {"CON", "PRN", "AUX", "NUL", *("COM" + str(i) for i in range(1, 10)), *("LPT" + str(i) for i in range(1, 10))}, "reserved Windows version ID forbidden")
    return value


def sha_bytes(data):
    return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()


def _link(path):
    return path.is_symlink() or getattr(path, "is_junction", lambda: False)()


def docs_root(root):
    raw = Path(root).absolute()
    pc.require(raw.is_dir() and not _link(raw), "documentation root must exist and must not be a symlink/junction")
    base = raw.resolve()
    pc.require(base.name.casefold() not in FORBIDDEN, "root is a protected configuration/memory/repository directory")
    repo_docs_root = None
    for ancestor in [base, *base.parents]:
        pc.require(ancestor.name.casefold() not in {"memory", "memories", "config", "configuration", "skills", "agents", "plugins"}, "documentation root must stay outside configuration/memory/pack sources")
        if (ancestor / ".git").exists() or (ancestor / "Cargo.toml").exists():
            repo_docs_root = ancestor
            break
    if repo_docs_root is not None:
        # Permit the shared docs/predev root for compatibility, or one
        # project-specific directory directly below it. The policy still
        # allowlists this exact root and exact document paths.
        docs = repo_docs_root / "docs"
        predev = docs / "predev"
        shared_root = base == predev
        project_root = base.parent == predev and base.name.casefold() not in FORBIDDEN
        pc.require(shared_root or project_root, "repository documentation root must be exactly docs/predev or docs/predev/<project>")
        pc.require((repo_docs_root / ".git").exists(), "repository documentation root must be under a Git repository")
    for path in base.rglob("*"):
        pc.require(not _link(path), "symlink/junction forbidden in documentation root: " + str(path.relative_to(base)))
        pc.require(path.name.casefold() not in FORBIDDEN, "protected entry in documentation root: " + str(path.relative_to(base)))
        if path.is_file():
            pc.require(path.suffix.casefold() in DOC_EXTENSIONS, "non-document file in documentation root: " + str(path.relative_to(base)))
    return base


def doc_path(value):
    path = pc.normalized_path(value)
    pc.require(not any(part.casefold() in FORBIDDEN for part in path.split("/")), "protected path forbidden")
    pc.require(Path(path).suffix.casefold() in DOC_EXTENSIONS, "proposal accepts documentation files only")
    pc.require(not any(char in path for char in '<>"|?*'), "Windows path alias/glob forbidden")
    for part in path.split("/"):
        pc.require(part == part.rstrip(" ."), "trailing dot/space path alias forbidden")
        stem = part.split(".")[0].upper()
        pc.require(stem not in {"CON", "PRN", "AUX", "NUL", *("COM" + str(i) for i in range(1, 10)), *("LPT" + str(i) for i in range(1, 10))}, "reserved Windows path forbidden")
    return path


def _read_snapshot(path):
    raw = Path(path).read_bytes()
    value = pc.read_json(path)
    pc.require(Path(path).read_bytes() == raw, "input changed while being read")
    return value, sha_bytes(raw)


def _pack(pack_root, manifest_path):
    manifest = pc.verify_manifest(pack_root, manifest_path)
    for filename in ("predev_host.py", "predev_control.py"):
        matches = [entry for entry in manifest["files"] if Path(entry["path"]).name == filename]
        pc.require(len(matches) == 1, "pack must bind exactly one " + filename)
        runtime = Path(__file__).with_name(filename)
        pc.require(pc.file_hash(runtime) == matches[0]["sha256"], "pack differs from running helper/controller: " + filename)
    return manifest


def _catalogue(root):
    result = {}
    folder = root / "candidates"
    if not folder.exists():
        return result
    pc.require(folder.is_dir(), "candidates must be a directory")
    for directory in sorted(folder.iterdir()):
        pc.require(directory.is_dir(), "unexpected candidate entry")
        key = safe_id(directory.name, "stored candidate")
        receipt = pc.read_json(directory / "receipt.json")
        manifest = pc.verify_manifest(root, directory / "manifest.json")
        pc.require(receipt.get("kind") == "HOST_PERSISTED" and receipt.get("scope") in ("DESIGN", "PLANS"), "invalid stored receipt")
        pc.require(receipt.get("target_candidate_id") == key == manifest["candidate_id"] and receipt["scope"] == manifest["scope"], "stored candidate identity mismatch")
        pc.require(type(receipt.get("generation")) is int and receipt["generation"] > 0, "stored generation invalid")
        paths = {entry["path"] for entry in manifest["files"]}
        pc.require({"candidates/" + key + "/receipt.json", "candidates/" + key + "/proposal.json"} <= paths, "stored receipt/proposal must be bound to manifest")
        pc.require(key.casefold() not in {name.casefold() for name in result}, "candidate ID case collision")
        result[key] = {"receipt": receipt, "manifest": manifest}
    for key, item in result.items():
        receipt = item["receipt"]
        parent = receipt["base_candidate_id"]
        if parent is None:
            pc.require(receipt["generation"] == 1, "initial candidate generation mismatch")
        else:
            pc.require(parent in result and result[parent]["receipt"]["scope"] == receipt["scope"], "stored base scope missing/mismatch")
            pc.require(receipt["generation"] == result[parent]["receipt"]["generation"] + 1, "stored candidate generation mismatch")
    for scope in ("DESIGN", "PLANS"):
        generations = [v["receipt"]["generation"] for v in result.values() if v["receipt"]["scope"] == scope]
        pc.require(len(generations) == len(set(generations)), "candidate history fork detected")
    return result


def _transports(root, catalogue):
    folder = root / "transports"
    if not folder.exists():
        return {}
    pc.require(folder.is_dir(), "transports must be a directory")
    result = {}
    for directory in sorted(folder.iterdir()):
        pc.require(directory.is_dir(), "unexpected transport entry")
        key = safe_id(directory.name, "transport ID")
        manifest_path = directory / "transport-manifest.json"
        manifest = pc.read_json(manifest_path)
        pc.require(isinstance(manifest, dict) and set(manifest) == {"schema", "transport_id", "base_candidate_id", "files", "digest"}, "invalid transport manifest")
        pc.require(manifest_path.read_bytes() == pc.canonical(manifest), "transport manifest must be canonical")
        pc.require(manifest["schema"] == "rust-predev-transport/1" and manifest["transport_id"] == key and manifest["base_candidate_id"] in catalogue, "transport identity/base mismatch")
        pc.require(manifest["digest"] == pc.payload_digest({k: v for k, v in manifest.items() if k != "digest"}), "transport digest mismatch")
        pc.proofs(root, manifest["files"], "transport files", nonempty=True)
        paths = [entry["path"] for entry in manifest["files"]]
        pc.require(paths == pc.unique_paths(paths, canonical_input=True) and all(p.startswith("transports/" + key + "/") for p in paths), "transport corpus outside its immutable version")
        pc.require({"transports/" + key + "/receipt.json", "transports/" + key + "/proposal.json"} <= set(paths), "transport receipt/proposal not bound")
        receipt = pc.read_json(directory / "receipt.json")
        pc.require(receipt.get("target_candidate_id") == key and receipt.get("scope") == "TRANSPORT", "transport receipt mismatch")
        result[key] = receipt
    return result


def _head(catalogue, scope):
    values = [(v["receipt"]["generation"], key) for key, v in catalogue.items() if v["receipt"]["scope"] == scope]
    return max(values)[1] if values else None


def audit(root, proposal_path, policy_path, pack_root, pack_manifest):
    root = docs_root(root)
    proposal, proposal_hash = _read_snapshot(proposal_path)
    policy, policy_hash = _read_snapshot(policy_path)
    pc.require(isinstance(policy, dict) and policy.get("schema") == SCHEMA, "invalid host policy schema")
    pc.identifier(policy.get("host_actor"), "policy.host_actor")
    pc.identifier(policy.get("proposal_actor"), "policy.proposal_actor")
    pc.require(policy["host_actor"] != policy["proposal_actor"], "host and readOnly proposal actors must be distinct")
    roots = policy.get("roots")
    pc.require(isinstance(roots, list) and roots and all(isinstance(p, str) and Path(p).is_absolute() for p in roots), "policy roots must be an explicit absolute allowlist")
    pc.require(root in [Path(p).resolve() for p in roots], "documentation root is not allowlisted")
    allowed = pc.unique_paths(policy.get("paths"), canonical_input=True)
    for path in allowed:
        doc_path(path)
    pc.proof(root, policy.get("source"), "host authorization source")
    pc.require(isinstance(proposal, dict) and proposal.get("schema") == SCHEMA, "invalid host proposal schema")
    scope = proposal.get("scope")
    pc.require(scope in ("DESIGN", "PLANS", "TRANSPORT"), "host proposal scope invalid")
    keys = {"schema", "scope", "proposal_id", "actor", "base_candidate_id", "target_candidate_id", "pack_digest", "files"}
    if scope == "PLANS":
        keys.add("design_candidate_id")
    pc.require(set(proposal) == keys, "proposal fields or scope/parent mismatch")
    safe_id(proposal["proposal_id"], "proposal_id")
    target = safe_id(proposal["target_candidate_id"], "target_candidate_id")
    base = proposal["base_candidate_id"]
    if base is not None:
        safe_id(base, "base_candidate_id")
    pc.require(target != base, "target candidate must be new")
    pc.require(proposal["actor"] == policy["proposal_actor"], "proposal actor not authorized by policy")
    pack = _pack(pack_root, pack_manifest)
    pc.require(proposal["pack_digest"] == pack["digest"], "proposal pack digest stale/mismatch")
    catalogue = _catalogue(root)
    transports = _transports(root, catalogue)
    used = [*catalogue, *transports]
    pc.require(target.casefold() not in {p.casefold() for p in used}, "immutable target already exists or collides")
    receipts = [entry["receipt"] for entry in catalogue.values()] + list(transports.values())
    pc.require(proposal["proposal_id"] not in {r["proposal_id"] for r in receipts}, "proposal_id already persisted")
    if scope == "TRANSPORT":
        pc.require(base in catalogue and base == _head(catalogue, catalogue[base]["receipt"]["scope"]), "transport base candidate missing/stale")
    else:
        pc.require(base == _head(catalogue, scope), "base candidate stale or wrong scope")
    if scope == "PLANS":
        design = safe_id(proposal["design_candidate_id"], "design_candidate_id")
        pc.require(design == _head(catalogue, "DESIGN") and design is not None, "PLANS parent DESIGN missing/stale")
        pc.require(target != design, "PLANS ID must differ from DESIGN parent")
    files = proposal["files"]
    pc.require(isinstance(files, list) and files, "proposal files must be nonempty array")
    contents, normalized = {}, []
    for entry in files:
        pc.require(isinstance(entry, dict) and set(entry) == {"path", "content", "base_sha256"}, "proposal file must be {path,content,base_sha256}")
        path = doc_path(entry["path"])
        normalized.append(path)
        pc.require(path in allowed and path.casefold() not in RESERVED, "proposal path outside exact documentation allowlist or reserved")
        pc.require(isinstance(entry["content"], str), "proposal content must be UTF-8 text")
        content = entry["content"].encode("utf-8")
        expected_base = None
        if base is not None and scope != "TRANSPORT":
            candidate_path = root / "candidates" / base / path
            if candidate_path.exists():
                pc.require(candidate_path.is_file(), "base path must be file")
                expected_base = pc.file_hash(candidate_path)
                corpus_paths = {f["path"] for f in catalogue[base]["manifest"]["files"]}
                pc.require(candidate_path.relative_to(root).as_posix() in corpus_paths, "base file not bound to its manifest")
        pc.require(entry["base_sha256"] == expected_base, "base file SHA256 missing/stale: " + path)
        contents[path] = content
    sorted_paths = pc.unique_paths(normalized, canonical_input=True)
    for path in sorted_paths:
        pc.require(not any(other.casefold().startswith(path.casefold() + "/") for other in sorted_paths if other != path), "file/directory path collision")
    folder = "transports" if scope == "TRANSPORT" else "candidates"
    destination = root / folder / target
    pc.require(not destination.exists(), "immutable destination already exists")
    generation = 1 if base is None or scope == "TRANSPORT" else catalogue[base]["receipt"]["generation"] + 1
    return {"ok": True, "mode": "AUDIT", "root": str(root), "destination": str(destination),
            "proposal": proposal, "proposal_sha256": proposal_hash, "policy_sha256": policy_hash,
            "generation": generation, "pack_digest": pack["digest"], "host_actor": policy["host_actor"],
            "authority_source": policy["source"], "files": [{"path": p, "sha256": sha_bytes(contents[p])} for p in sorted_paths]}


def _write(path, data):
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    with path.open("xb") as stream:
        stream.write(data)
        stream.flush()
        os.fsync(stream.fileno())


def apply(root, proposal_path, policy_path, pack_root, pack_manifest):
    checked = audit(root, proposal_path, policy_path, pack_root, pack_manifest)
    root = Path(checked["root"])
    lock = root / ".predev-host-lock"
    try:
        lock.mkdir()
    except FileExistsError as exc:
        raise pc.ControlError("another host writer is active; inspect existing lock without deleting it automatically") from exc
    try:
        pc.require(audit(root, proposal_path, policy_path, pack_root, pack_manifest) == checked, "inputs changed while acquiring host lock")
        return _apply_checked(root, proposal_path, policy_path, pack_root, pack_manifest, checked)
    finally:
        lock.rmdir()


def _apply_checked(root, proposal_path, policy_path, pack_root, pack_manifest, checked):
    proposal = checked["proposal"]
    # Windows Python 3.13 treats 0700 as a private ACL; inherit the already
    # authorized documentation-root ACL instead of publishing private temp ACLs.
    stage = root / (".predev-stage-" + uuid.uuid4().hex)
    stage.mkdir(mode=0o777, exist_ok=False)
    destination = Path(checked["destination"])
    parent_created = False
    try:
        for entry in proposal["files"]:
            _write(stage / doc_path(entry["path"]), entry["content"].encode("utf-8"))
        receipt = {"schema": SCHEMA, "kind": "HOST_PERSISTED", "scope": proposal["scope"],
                   "proposal_id": proposal["proposal_id"], "actor": proposal["actor"], "persisted_by": checked["host_actor"],
                   "base_candidate_id": proposal["base_candidate_id"], "target_candidate_id": proposal["target_candidate_id"],
                   "generation": checked["generation"], "proposal_sha256": checked["proposal_sha256"],
                   "policy_sha256": checked["policy_sha256"], "pack_digest": checked["pack_digest"],
                   "authority_source": checked["authority_source"], "files": checked["files"]}
        if proposal["scope"] == "PLANS":
            receipt["design_candidate_id"] = proposal["design_candidate_id"]
        _write(stage / "proposal.json", pc.canonical(proposal))
        _write(stage / "receipt.json", pc.canonical(receipt))
        local_paths = [entry["path"] for entry in checked["files"]] + ["proposal.json", "receipt.json"]
        prefix = destination.relative_to(root).as_posix()
        corpus = [{"path": prefix + "/" + p, "sha256": pc.file_hash(stage / p)} for p in local_paths]
        if proposal["scope"] == "TRANSPORT":
            payload = {"schema": "rust-predev-transport/1", "transport_id": proposal["target_candidate_id"],
                       "base_candidate_id": proposal["base_candidate_id"], "files": sorted(corpus, key=lambda p: p["path"])}
            manifest = dict(payload, digest=pc.payload_digest(payload))
            manifest_name = "transport-manifest.json"
        else:
            # Use controller to hash the actual staged corpus, then map to final immutable paths.
            manifest = pc.create_manifest(stage, proposal["scope"], proposal["target_candidate_id"], local_paths,
                                          proposal.get("design_candidate_id"))
            manifest["files"] = corpus
            if proposal["scope"] == "PLANS":
                parent = "candidates/" + proposal["design_candidate_id"] + "/manifest.json"
                manifest["files"].append({"path": parent, "sha256": pc.file_hash(pc.rooted(root, parent))})
            manifest["files"].sort(key=lambda p: p["path"])
            manifest["digest"] = pc.payload_digest({k: v for k, v in manifest.items() if k != "digest"})
            manifest_name = "manifest.json"
        _write(stage / manifest_name, pc.canonical(manifest))
        rechecked = audit(root, proposal_path, policy_path, pack_root, pack_manifest)
        pc.require(rechecked == checked, "proposal/policy/source/base/pack changed before promotion")
        if not destination.parent.exists():
            destination.parent.mkdir()
            parent_created = True
        pc.require(not destination.exists(), "immutable target appeared during promotion")
        os.rename(stage, destination)
        return {"ok": True, "mode": "HOST_PERSISTED", "scope": proposal["scope"],
                "destination": str(destination), "receipt": str(destination / "receipt.json"),
                "manifest_digest": manifest["digest"], "files": checked["files"],
                "actor": proposal["actor"], "persisted_by": checked["host_actor"]}
    finally:
        if stage.exists():
            pc.require(stage.parent == root and stage.name.startswith(".predev-stage-") and not _link(stage), "unsafe staging cleanup refused")
            shutil.rmtree(stage)
        if parent_created and destination.parent.exists() and not any(destination.parent.iterdir()):
            destination.parent.rmdir()


def main(argv=None):
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    sub = parser.add_subparsers(dest="command", required=True)
    for name in ("audit", "apply"):
        item = sub.add_parser(name)
        for option in ("root", "proposal", "policy", "pack-root", "pack-manifest"):
            item.add_argument("--" + option, required=True)
    args = parser.parse_args(argv)
    try:
        function = audit if args.command == "audit" else apply
        result = function(args.root, args.proposal, args.policy, args.pack_root, args.pack_manifest)
        if args.command == "audit":
            result = {k: v for k, v in result.items() if k != "proposal"}
        sys.stdout.buffer.write(pc.canonical(result))
        return 0
    except (pc.ControlError, OSError, UnicodeError, TypeError, KeyError) as exc:
        sys.stderr.write("predev-host: " + str(exc) + "\n")
        return 1


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Compare an exported UTF-8 source with a TRANSPORT proposal and saved raw file."""
import argparse
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import sys

sys.dont_write_bytecode = True
import predev_control as pc


def verify(source_path, proposal_path=None, transport_path=None, proposal_file=None):
    pc.require(proposal_path is not None or transport_path is not None,
               "proposal or transport is required")
    source = Path(source_path).read_bytes()
    source.decode("utf-8")
    result = {"ok": True, "source_sha256": hashlib.sha256(source).hexdigest(),
              "source_bytes": len(source)}
    if proposal_path is not None:
        proposal = pc.read_json(proposal_path)
        pc.require(isinstance(proposal, dict) and proposal.get("scope") == "TRANSPORT",
                   "proposal must have TRANSPORT scope")
        files = proposal.get("files")
        pc.require(isinstance(files, list), "proposal files must be an array")
        matches = [entry for entry in files if isinstance(entry, dict) and
                   (entry.get("path") == proposal_file if proposal_file else True)]
        pc.require(len(matches) == 1, "select exactly one proposal file")
        content = matches[0].get("content")
        pc.require(isinstance(content, str), "proposal content must be text")
        pc.require(content.encode("utf-8") == source,
                   "proposal content differs from source bytes")
        result["proposal_file"] = matches[0]["path"]
        result["proposal_actor"] = proposal.get("actor")
        result["proposal_base_candidate_id"] = proposal.get("base_candidate_id")
    if transport_path is not None:
        transport = Path(transport_path).read_bytes()
        pc.require(transport == source, "transport file differs from source bytes")
        result["transport_sha256"] = hashlib.sha256(transport).hexdigest()
    return result


def main(argv=None):
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--source", required=True, help="faithful UTF-8 export of the original contribution")
    parser.add_argument("--proposal", help="TRANSPORT proposal JSON before persistence")
    parser.add_argument("--proposal-file", help="path of the raw item in proposal.files")
    parser.add_argument("--transport", help="raw file saved by the documentation host")
    args = parser.parse_args(argv)
    try:
        result = verify(args.source, args.proposal, args.transport, args.proposal_file)
    except (OSError, UnicodeError, pc.ControlError) as exc:
        parser.exit(2, "raw handoff verification failed: " + str(exc) + "\n")
    print(json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

- `1 ≤ max_samples ≤ 80_000` vérifié avant allocation et avant décodage. Les canaux/fréquence normalisés sont exactement **mono / 16 kHz**.

- La sérialisation actuelle en JSON de 80 000 valeurs PCM16 tient dans 1 MiB : borne conservatrice **560 000 octets** pour valeurs et séparateurs, hors métadonnées. L’émetteur doit néanmoins vérifier la taille réelle totale avant envoi. Aucun envoi en plusieurs frames implicite.

Une éventuelle fenêtre différente doit être attribuée, justifiée et revue sur les contrats concernés.

**Saturation et arrêt.** Pour un import, le consommateur régule une source relisible : arrêter les demandes de blocs pendant la rétropression, sans modifier la source. L’UI reste non bloquante. File durablement indisponible, consommateur déconnecté, dépassement wire ou résultat invalide produisent une erreur explicite ; préserver les sorties déjà vérifiées et empêcher Complete tant que le publisher n’a pas confirmé les artefacts. Stop invalide la génération avant toute admission de nouveaux résultats et cesse la lecture/décodage suivant ; le contrôle coopératif peut demander l’abandon natif. Aucun délai arbitraire de retour de FFI n’est promis, aucun kill automatique ajouté. Quitter reste ouvert si l’enfant ne confirme pas son arrêt, conformément à D19.

**Résultats obsolètes.** Vérifier version, `job_id`, génération, requête, séquence et plage avant la mutation de l’application ou du publisher. Le simple remplissage d’une file ne constitue ni ACK durable ni confirmation de fragment. Les plafonds IPC n’ajoutent aucune limite au nombre total d’imports restaurables ou à la taille des archives ; ces politiques relèvent des lots suivants.

## 3. Contrat application/effets proposé

Une famille de port réellement nécessaire suffit : `ImportIoPort`, **possédée par application**, avec admission non bloquante d’effets typés et polling non bloquant d’événements. Les noms Rust restent proposés ; les obligations suivantes sont le contrat.

**État métier :** ImportApplication possède job/génération, snapshot de langue/compute/destination, transitions, demande d’arrêt et décision de publication. UI possède champs/rendu. Adapter possède handles, processus et files techniques. Worker possède contexte natif et buffers.

**Commande de démarrage :** identité job/génération, référence source, langue/compute et destination sélectionnée. Le modèle local approuvé est une configuration pure injectée avec chemin/hash/taille. Les références de chemins sont des données ; seuls les adapters/worker les ouvrent.

**Snapshot :** le dossier est figé quand le job est accepté au démarrage. Modifier le choix UI affecte le suivant, sans déplacement ni suppression, conformément à Q-05. Aucun modèle n’est téléchargé dans ce parcours.

| Effet / sortie | Préconditions et erreurs | Effets, annulation, durabilité |
|---|---|---|
| Préparer source/modèle/destination → événement Prepared | Pas de job actif ; référence résoluble ; source et modèle ouverts en lecture seule ; modèle hash/taille approuvés ; erreurs absent, modifié, format, hash, accès, espace | Hors UI ; produire identité source et pending durable avant démarrage ; aucun accusé durable fondé sur RAM |
| Démarrer worker → Ready/Progress/Segment/End | Prepared valide, CPU demandé pour ce lot, protocole accepté, source revalidée | Enfant CPU sans contexte GPU ; Ready après initialisation/attestation ; chaque événement corrélé au job/génération/instance |
| Persister fragment → reçu de persistance | Identité courante ; plage/séquence valide ; segment non dupliqué | Append/version du staging, sync avant reçu ; source jamais modifiée |
| Publier archive → reçu vérifié | End réussi, tous fragments attendus reçus/persistés ; pas de cancel | TXT/SRT/manifeste vérifiés ; pointeur publié dernier ; Complete seulement après reçu cohérent |
| Scanner → entrées Complete/Recoverable | Racine autorisée, lecture des snapshots/manifeste/pending | Aucun démarrage restauré ; aucun nettoyage automatique ; double scan stable |
| Arrêter → Stopped/diagnostic | Job/génération correspondant | Admission indépendante du flux segments ; génération invalidée avant acceptation d’un résultat tardif ; conserver source/pending |

Une admission acceptée signifie uniquement « opération admise », jamais « archive durable » ou « job terminé ». Une saturation refuse la nouvelle opération avec erreur visible, conserve le dernier état prouvé et arrête l’entrée concernée. Aucune commande critique ni fragment confirmé n’est silencieusement supprimé.

L’application ordonne ces effets et valide leurs reçus. L’adapter exécute leur mécanisme technique ; il ne décide ni second démarrage, ni fallback, ni Complete.

Erreurs publiques à distinguer : Busy, InvalidInput, SourceMissing/Changed, ModelMissing/HashMismatch, UnsupportedLanguage/Format, StorageUnavailable/Full/Corrupt, ProtocolMismatch, WorkerExited, BackendMismatch, Saturated, Cancelled et StaleResponse. Leur codage exact reste DETAIL, mais une chaîne générique ne doit pas effacer la distinction nécessaire aux transitions/récupération.

## 4. Concurrence, limites et arrêt

**Décisions techniques proposées à revoir :** un service IO parent dédié, un enfant CPU actif maximum, canaux `std::sync::mpsc::sync_channel` ; aucun nouveau runtime async ni crate de concurrence. API UI : `try_send`/`try_recv`, jamais `recv`, `join`, hash, lecture disque ou inférence. [Canal borné std](https://doc.rust-lang.org/std/sync/mpsc/fn.sync_channel.html), consulté le 2026-10-05.

Bornes proposées : 8 effets en attente, 64 événements persistables en attente, trame IPC plafonnée à 1 MiB, un bloc PCM de décodage limité par `max_samples` validé avant allocation. Une trame trop grande est rejetée explicitement ; le texte n’est pas tronqué. Les segments à persister subissent la rétropression. Le rendu provisoire peut être remplacé par sa dernière valeur ; aucun fragment durable ne l’est.

Le canal de contrôle ne partage pas la capacité data : état d’arrêt dédié par identité/instance, consultable indépendamment par le service IO et le lecteur contrôle enfant. Les opérations disque et inférence restent bloquantes hors UI. Les fenêtres PCM/inférence et leur mapping SRT doivent être bornés sans imposer une limite globale de durée du fichier.

**Arrêt borné réel :** l’admission Stop/Quit et le polling UI sont non bloquants et effectuent un nombre fini d’opérations par tick. Aucun délai maximum de terminaison FFI/disque n’est promis. Une attente ou panne est affichée ; Quitter reste ouvert jusqu’à résolution ou action manuelle selon D19. Aucun kill automatique ni `Drop` faisant un join infini sur UI.

Un arrêt coopératif reconnu donne Stopped, puis libération des handles. EOF/erreur de protocole/exit inattendu est supervisé et mène à Recoverable/diagnostic. Le vieux processus, sa génération ou un événement après annulation ne peuvent publier d’archive.

**Q-L01-BOUNDS-01**, reversible_detail, owner architecte/AUTH-COORD, échéance avant code L01 : valider ces capacités et préciser la taille des fenêtres PCM à partir des WAV autorisés et des contrats d’offsets existants. Les nombres proposés sont des limites de ressources internes, sans promesse de latence ni réduction du périmètre produit.

Le V1 L00 est un socle non connecté. Il manque notamment une fin de transcription explicite et une corrélation complète de l’initialisation/erreur.

Proposer **IPC_PROTOCOL_VERSION = 2**, avec :

- préparation/démarrage corrélés à job/génération/instance et source hashée ;
- backend attesté ;
- segments identifiés et plages sur axe source ;
- événement End portant dernier offset/séquence attendue ;

## 6. Publication, recovery et migration

Import : TXT/SRT plus référence hashée à la source intacte, sans copie audio ni MP3. Écrire pending et génération immuable ; fermer/synchroniser chaque artefact ; vérifier tailles/hashes/identités ; produire manifeste puis pointeur courant dernier.

La publication concerne **cette génération d’archive sous la racine du job**. Elle n’est pas une transaction entre plusieurs fichiers ni une garantie contre toute panne électrique. [File::sync_all](https://doc.rust-lang.org/std/fs/struct.File.html#method.sync_all), consulté le 2026-10-05.

Après coupure : pending sans pointeur complet, pointeur invalide, artefact absent ou hash différent → Recoverable. Un ancien snapshot validé reste lisible ; la tentative courante ne devient pas Complete. Réconciliation idempotente, sans suppression automatique ni reprise de traitement.

Migration de **données produit préexistantes : N/A pour ce delta**, car L00 n’a livré ni écrivain d’archives/file ni paramètres durables. Schémas archive/pending versionnés à leur première écriture ; version inconnue refusée sans réécriture. Le changement IPC V1→V2 est une rupture des contrats de code, à couvrir dans les tests et le ledger futur, même en l’absence de migration de fichiers.

# États, persistance et contrats de ports — proposition D-WHISPER-09

Ce document précise les obligations logiques. Il ne prétend pas que la pile native les satisfait déjà. Les alternatives qui modifient le produit restent `Q` dans `10_QUESTIONS_RISKS_AND_READINESS.md`.

## Ownership et états

`application` est l'unique propriétaire du scheduler et de l'identité d'un job. `domain` valide les événements et invariants, sans IO. Un adaptateur capture possède le handle micro ; un worker possède le contexte moteur ; l'UI n'en possède aucun. Un `job_id` stable, une `generation` monotone et un `segment_id`/offset original identifient chaque résultat. Un résultat d'une génération annulée est rejeté. Un `transcription_id` regroupe plusieurs `passage_id` live lorsque Stop + Reprise est utilisé ; chaque passage reste un job/finalisation distinct. La file d'import durable est distincte de l'index d'historique reconstruit.

| Flux | États métier/durables | États visibles | Événement, précondition, effet et issue d'erreur |
|---|---|---|---|
| Live | `Absent → Preparing → Capturing → Draining → Finalizing → Complete` ; `Recoverable` si coupure/erreur après fragments confirmés | Idle, Starting, Live, Stopping, Recoverable, Complete | Start seulement si aucun job actif ; micro ouvert après validation ; Stop coupe l'entrée puis draine les échantillons déjà captés, confirme les fragments et publie. Erreur micro/worker/disque : cesser capture, conserver état récupérable, afficher cause. Second Start : refus `AC-01`. |
| Import | `Queued → AwaitingChoice` après redémarrage ; `Queued → Running → Finalizing → Complete` après choix ; `Interrupted`/`Cancelled` séparés | Queued, AwaitingChoice, Running, Cancelling, Interrupted, Complete | Enqueue après validation et écriture durable, sans toucher source ; démarrage seulement si aucun live actif et règle Q-01 satisfaite ; Retirer supprime entrée, pas source ; crash Running ne rejoint pas Queued et ne redémarre jamais automatiquement. |
| Archive | `Staging → Verified → Complete` ou `Recoverable` | Processing, Complete ou Recoverable | Chaque sortie est écrite en staging, fermée et vérifiée ; un marqueur de complétude durable est publié **en dernier** ; l'historique ne qualifie Complete qu'avec marqueur et fichiers vérifiés. Échec intermédiaire : Recoverable et aucune annonce Complete. |
| Paramètres | `Current(version) → Candidate → Current(version+1)` | Valeur courante, erreur de validation | Valider nouvelle valeur, écrire fichier temporaire, synchroniser, remplacer selon garantie filesystem vérifiée ; une erreur conserve Current. Un job existant garde son snapshot `JobConfig`. |

`Draining` est la fin de capture, **avant** la fin de finalisation. L'import demandé durant live ne peut démarrer qu'après l'état `Complete`/`Recoverable` stabilisé ; plusieurs imports passent un par un en ordre de demande, jamais au seul arrêt du micro. `Stop + Reprise` clôt le passage courant et arme la possibilité d'un nouveau passage dans le même groupe, mais le nouveau Start exige une impulsion utilisateur attestée. Le passage N est Complete ou Recoverable avant N+1 ; les identifiants et offsets restent distincts. Fermer la fenêtre ne change aucun état métier. Quitter demande l'arrêt ; si worker/encodeur bloque, l'application signale l'état et **reste ouverte** jusqu'à résolution ou action manuelle, sans annoncer une sortie réussie.

## Point de confirmation et récupération

Une confirmation de fragment n'est émise qu'après que les octets audio correspondants, le texte confirmé, leurs identifiants et offsets ont été rendus durables selon une stratégie vérifiée sur le volume cible. Les segments provisoires et les buffers non confirmés restent explicitement perdables. Le journal de session est append-only ou versionné avec checksum ; la mise en mémoire de l'UI n'est jamais une confirmation. Le point de confirmation et la fréquence de sync devront être mesurés par `SPIKE-02` ; ce texte définit la **garantie à démontrer**, pas une API ou cadence validée. Au redémarrage : scanner les fragments confirmés, écarter dernier enregistrement incomplet, dédupliquer `(job_id, segment_id, offset)` ; calculer et afficher la plage non confirmée perdue. `AC-13` teste des coupures à chaque frontière.

La file durable d'imports utilise un enregistrement versionné avec identifiant stable, chemin source, hash ou identité source à revérifier, état et ordre de demande. L'accusé « en attente » n'arrive qu'après persistance vérifiée. Restaurer une entrée ne valide pas que le fichier source existe encore : Traiter revérifie la source et rend l'erreur visible. `Running` après crash devient `Interrupted` ; le retour à `Queued` demande **confirmation explicite** ; reprise depuis début ou checkpoint prouvé doit éviter les doublons. Le journal de file n'est pas un historique de transcriptions.

Les archives de capture live sont un dossier de transcription avec `passage_id.mp3` pour chaque passage et TXT/SRT cumulés. Le manifeste de sortie contient versions, tailles, hashes, offsets de passage et offsets de groupe, ainsi que le statut de chaque passage et du groupe. La pause entre passages apparaît sur l'axe de groupe ; le MP3 de chaque passage ne contient que son propre audio, silences internes conservés. Le texte/SRT cumulé est reconstruit de fragments confirmés avec décalage de groupe ; un passage Recoverable reste explicitement marqué et ne rend pas tout le groupe Complete par défaut. Il n'existe aucune transaction atomique entre les fichiers : écrire sous nom de staging, fermer/synchroniser, vérifier, puis publier un marqueur `Complete` en dernier pour la version du groupe. Au scan, marqueur absent ou hash discordant signifie `Recoverable`, même si des fichiers finaux existent. En cas de coupure pendant le marqueur, la réconciliation revalide les artefacts requis et décide Complete ou Recoverable de façon idempotente. Pour un import, les artefacts requis sont TXT/SRT et référence validée à la source à son chemin d'origine, **aucun MP3 archivé** ; ne pas copier l'audio source par défaut. `AC-10/12/13/20` couvrent les coupures. Les primitives Windows exactes et leur comportement sur le volume cible restent à prouver par `SPIKE-02`.

## Concurrence, saturation et arrêt

- Une capture live et un import actif sont mutuellement exclus dans le scheduler ; des demandes d'import peuvent être durablement en file pendant live. Politique multi-imports et ordre : Q-01.
- Capture et écriture audio ne dépendent jamais du thread UI. Inference et décodage peuvent bloquer dans un worker supervisé. Le canal UI peut jeter des rendus provisoires obsolètes, **jamais** un fragment audio non confirmé ni une commande critique sans diagnostic. Chaque canal a une capacité finie dimensionnée par `SPIKE-02` ; saturation propage une rétropression, puis un état d'erreur/récupération explicite si la capture ne peut suivre. Aucune politique de perte silencieuse.
- Les commandes Start/Stop/Quitter portent `job_id` et `generation` ; une répétition est idempotente ou refusée sans deuxième handle. L'arrêt ferme d'abord l'entrée audio, puis draine et synchronise les confirmations, puis attend worker/encodeur. Si bloqué, le superviseur diagnostique et signale ; le processus principal reste ouvert jusqu'à résolution ou **action manuelle explicite**. `SPIKE-02` mesure les blocages et les possibilités de récupération sans supposer une sortie forcée.
- Auto GPU→CPU reprend au dernier `(segment_id, offset)` confirmé ; un résultat tardif GPU d'ancienne génération est rejeté. Les échantillons confirmés restent inchangés ; les non confirmés sont rejoués depuis audio durable si disponible, sinon la perte mesurée est signalée. GPU forcé exige une nouvelle décision utilisateur. Cette stratégie exige la preuve `SPIKE-01` pour le moteur réel.

## INSTALL — exécution locale sans capacité réseau

`e1_offline.py` a recopié dans le dossier privé d’un AppContainer Windows les deux EXE, trois DLL CUDA privées et le modèle de `e1-install/primary` ; les six paires ont des SHA256 identiques et les tailles sont consignées dans `e1-offline-report.json`. Les sources `appcontainer-launch.cpp` et `network-probe.cpp`, le script de build et les quatre logs d’exécution sont manifestés dans `evidence/d19/`. L’AppContainer `WhisperDesignD19Offline` a zéro capacité réseau ; le launcher vérifie `TokenIsAppContainer=1` pour chaque enfant. Selon la [documentation Microsoft AppContainer](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/win32/secauthz/implementing-an-appcontainer), sans capacité réseau le processus ne peut pas accéder au réseau. Un témoin TCP vers `127.0.0.1:8765` se connecte hors conteneur puis échoue (`WSA 10060`) dans ce même conteneur. Les workers CPU et GPU y chargent le modèle local exact, transcrivent le même WAV, terminent avec code 0 et rapportent leur backend respectif. Le modèle et les exécutables hashés correspondent au payload retenu, sans transfert réseau par ces processus. Les logs montrent les paramètres et l’identité du jeton. Le profil Windows est un banc d’isolation, non le packaging produit prévu.

Ce résultat ferme la lacune de preuve offline de D18 dans ce banc. Il n’éprouve ni PC propre, ni runtime absent, ni installateur final, ni acquisition HTTPS/redirections externe ; ces éléments restent préflight/qualification ultérieurs. Le modèle n’est pas fourni dans le corpus documentaire en raison de sa taille : hash/taille et Ready original sont manifestés en D18, et la copie exacte est contrôlée dans le rapport D19.

## MODES — erreur worker et validation commune

Le nouveau worker `engine_attested.rs` installe un callback natif versionné, crée contexte puis state, et contrôle les logs `CUDA0`/CPU **avant** `state.full`. Une demande GPU qui n’atteste pas CUDA0 échoue sans lancer `state.full` ; le log `engine-attested-gpu-absent` le démontre avec `CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=-1`. CPU et GPU réussis émettent `backend_attested=... before_full=true`. Le même worker accepte une injection `fail-after-inference` qui quitte réellement avec code 73 après un calcul GPU attesté.

Le contrôleur `e2_state.rs` reçoit les événements processus dans une méthode commune `Controller.accept`. En strict, code 73 donne `Stopped`, sans lancement CPU ni insertion dans `committed`. En Auto, le même code 73 invalide génération 1 et choisit CPU. Un résultat GPU génération 1 réellement calculé est ensuite livré au même validateur : il est rejeté avant le chemin `committed.push`. La fenêtre 2 est rejouée sur l’EXE CPU à 15960–22500 ms ; les trois fenêtres publiées portent 0–14460, 15960–22500, 24000–30000 ms sans chevauchement et les générations 1/2 attendues. `e2-state-report.json` lie SHA des sources, locks, deux EXE et logs ; le run se termine 0. L’injection 73 n’est pas une panne physique de pilote, le commit du banc est en mémoire, et le produit final n’existe pas.
